replicate_compare — DRIVE grind op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.replicate_compare(groups: 'dict', log: 'bool' = True) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import grind; grind.replicate_compare(groups: 'dict', log: 'bool' = True) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("replicate_compare"))

Usage

Lays out the scatter between independent trials and the differences between groups (materials) on the same scale.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

groups: 名前 → (n_runs, n_conditions) の配列(例: 材料ごとに 3 回 × 7 時点の D50)。全群で n_conditions が同じ。log=True は ln をとってから比べる(径の比のばらつき = 変動係数に近い)。返り: spread(群 → 条件ごとの mean・sd・ cv(SD/平均、元の尺度)、cv_pooled(cv の二乗平均の根)、cv_max)、separation(群の組 → 条件ごとの |Δ平均| / √(SE₁² + SE₂²)(SE = SD/√n)と、その最小 min_z。鍵は "名前1|名前2" の文字列)。試行が 2 未満 → ValueError。
